paite: Sharon pak ka hi, phaizang lili pak.
english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

paite: Ling lak a lili pak bang in, huchibang in tanute lak ah ka it a-om hi.
heading: Pasal
english: As a lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

paite: Gamlak singte lak a epul kung bang in, huchibang in tapate lak ah ka ngaihnou a-om hi. Nakpi a kipahna toh aliim nuai ah ka tu a, agah ka chep in akhum hi.
heading: Numei
english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

paite: Ankuangluina inn ah ahon pi a, ka tung a kizak puanlap a-itna ahi.
english: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.

paite: Grep phoukeu in hon khou unla, epul thei in hon nem un; zawlngai in ka chi ana ngal a.
english: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples; for I am faint with love.

paite: Akhut veilam ka lu nuai ah a-om a, akhut taklam in ahon kawi hi.
english: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

paite: Zuktal leh gam a zukpite ka hon ngen hi, Aw Jerusalem tanute, ka it hihbuai kei unla, phawng kei un, alungkim matan.
english: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

paite: Ka ngaihnou aw! Ngai un, ahong hi, tangte tung ah atawm a, mual tungte ah adiang hi.
heading: La Nihna / Numei
english: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping on the mountains, skipping on the hills.

paite: Ka ngaihnou zaw zuktal hiam ahihkeileh sakhi tuailai bang ahi; Ngai in, ka kulhbaang nunglam uah adingh a, tohlette ah a-en a, anannate ah amah akimusak.
english: My beloved is like a roe or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall! He looks in at the windows. He glances through the lattice.

paite: Ka ngaihnou in thu agen a, ka kiang ah, "Pasal thou in, ka it, ka kilawmnou, hong pai meng in," achi hi.
heading: Pasal
english: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.

paite: Ngai in, phalbi lah abeita ngal a, vuah atheuta a, apaimangta hi;
english: For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.

paite: Leitung ah pakte hong kilang a; vasate lasak hun ahong tung a, i gam uah vakhu aw akizata hi.
english: The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.

paite: Theipi kung in gahhingte aminsak a, grep guite apaklun uhi, agimlimte uh asuaksak uhi. Thou ve, ka it, ka kilawmnou hong pai meng in.
english: The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”

paite: Mun sang a suangpi heng a om, vakhu bang na hi, na mel hon musak inla, na aw hon zasak in, na aw akhum a, na mel ahoih hi.
english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. Let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your face is lovely.

paite: Sehalte, grephuan hihsia, sehal neute hon matsak ve; ka grephuan uh apaklun ngal a.
english: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that plunder the vineyards; for our vineyards are in blossom.

paite: Ka ngaihnou kei a ahi, kei amah a ka hi; lili pak lak ah aganta aching a,
heading: Numei
english: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.

paite: Ni ahong nem a, limliapte aman matan, ka ngaihnou, kihei inla, Bether mual tung a zuktal hiam sakhi tuailai bang in om in.
english: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be like a roe or a young deer on the mountains of Bether.
